name: r6-ldg256-qkpair-r16
author: solx-loop
description: For B*S > 600, one CTA processes the same 16 rows of Q and of K. Each half-warp issues both 256-bit row loads before either reduction, so each thread has 64 B of DRAM reads in flight instead of 32 B. That raises the estimate per SM from 64 KB to about 96 KB at 6 CTAs/SM (39 regs on sm_100a). It also halves the CTA count, which cuts per-CTA launch and exit overhead in the 40-plus-wave one-shot grid.
